scenarios.name: dredge-mills-four-and-returns-thug
scenarios.why: With Golgari Thug in the graveyard and enough cards available, its controller may mill exactly four and return the Thug to hand instead of drawing. The padded library does not test the fewer-than-four-card restriction.

scenarios.name: not-in-graveyard-does-not-replace-draw
scenarios.why: Dredge works only from the graveyard. With Golgari Thug in hand, the turn-three draw happens normally and the Thug remains there.
